subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — EnterpriseFin
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harlow <tom.h@enterprisefin.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — EnterpriseFin

Hi Tom / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate you walking us through EnterpriseFin's current query routing and compliance constraints. Quick recap from our side and a proposed POC plan to validate Redwood for your production use case.

Demo highlights (short):
- End-to-end demo of Redwood API: generation, streaming, and embeddings for semantic search.
- Demonstrated routing policy prototype (latency tiering + fallbacks) and Redis-backed prefix caching.
- Quantization tradeoffs: 8-bit profile reduced throughput cost ~35% in our test model.

Proposed POC goals / success criteria:
1) Latency: 95th pctile token latency under 150ms for the live inference path with 2-3 concurrent requests per user (measured on your staging dataset).
2) Cost: Per-1000-token cost improvement >= 25% vs current hosted baseline (we'll provide cost modeling).
3) Quality: Top-3 relevance for the embeddings-driven assistant meets your internal rubric on the 50-item evaluation set (we'll work with Priya to map rubric).
4) Security & compliance: End-to-end audit logs & KMS integration validated for PII masking flows.

Proposed POC plan & timeline (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, access & baseline metrics collection (your staging env). Owner: EnterpriseFin (Priya).
- Week 1: Sweep testing + model/profile selection with Redwood. Owner: Redwood (Marissa/Dylan).
- Week 2: Integration test (routing policies, caching, KMS). Owner: EnterpriseFin + Redwood.
- Week 3: Evaluation against success criteria, cost modeling, and exec recap. Owner: both.

Owners / contacts:
- EnterpriseFin: Priya Menon (technical lead), Tom Harlow (product owner)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (eng lead), Dylan Brooks (solutions engineer), Camila Reyes (customer success)

Attachments: Redwood_POC_Plan_EnterpriseFin_v1.pdf (detailed steps + test checklists). I've also uploaded the recording from today's demo to the shared Drive link below.

Next steps / asks:
- Can Priya share staging access instructions and a short list of the 50 eval prompts by EOD Thursday?
- Confirm whether we should provision an initial Dedicated trial or run on Hosted with network peering for the POC.
- Proposed kickoff: Monday 20 Sep, 10am PT — does that work for your team?

Drive & assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOC_EnterpriseFin

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Marissa — thanks for the thorough recap and the POC doc, that all looks good at a high level. A few quick clarifications from our side before kickoff: 

1) Success criteria: for the embedding quality test we'll need to confirm the exact rubric — Priya will share the CSV of expected relevance scores. Is Redwood able to run the evaluation directly on our CSV (we can provide S3 access)?

2) Staging access: we have a staging cluster behind an IP allowlist and a small set of test accounts. Priya: can you share the IPs or a jumpbox credential?

3) Cost model: can Dylan provide the per-hour GPU estimate for the Dedicated trial vs Hosted-per-token baseline so we can include in procurement approval?

4) Kickoff: Monday 20 Sep 10am PT works for Product + Infra on our side. We may need Camila on that call to align on success criteria and reporting cadence.

Couple of additional asks: please include a short checklist for SOC2 evidence (log retention and KMS proof) in the POC doc so our security team can pre-scan.

Thanks — Tom
